blocks.text_contains: Out Run is a ground-breaking racing game in which the player drives a red Ferrari Testarossa
Each of the game's stages is packed with civilian traffic
At the end of every stage players are presented with a fork in the road
As well as being able to choose routes, players could also - via the game's "in-car radio" - choose one of three different catchy tunes
